# Support

## Getting help

- **Bug reports and feature requests**: [open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/ai-kit/issues/new)
- **Questions and discussion**: [AINative Discord](https://discord.com/invite/paipalooza)
- **Documentation**: [docs/](../docs/) in this repo, or [ainative.studio/ai-kit](https://ainative.studio/ai-kit)
- **Security vulnerabilities**: do not open a public issue — see [docs/security/](../docs/security/) if present, or email the maintainers directly.

## Before opening an issue

1. Check the [existing issues](https://github.com/AINative-Studio/ai-kit/issues) for duplicates.
2. Confirm which package the issue affects (`@ainative/ai-kit`, `@ainative/ai-kit-core`, etc.) and its version.
3. Include a minimal reproduction where possible — a repro that fails in isolation is the fastest path to a fix.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to submit changes.
